system.description:
Psionics: Fortress · cast at D-Rank to C-Rank · no type

+1 AC (+2 against Genjutsu attacks).

A creature that hits you with a melee weapon or Taijutsu attack makes an Intelligence save: on a failure it falls Prone and drops its weapon; on a critical failure its speed is also 0 until the end of its next turn.

rules.text: Psychic feedback: a creature that hits you with a melee weapon or Taijutsu attack makes an Intelligence save (your Genjutsu DC). Failure: it falls Prone and drops its weapon. Critical failure: also speed 0 until the end of its next turn.
